body: What a same-generation re-name means (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-10 03:22Z, from reading src/engram_source_roots.rs:2109-2118 and line 22). termal_name_source_root KEEPS the old generation only when all three hold: (1) the existing naming's claim_id equals the current claim id (the claim_fence is recorded but NOT matched, so a renewal or a recovery under the same claim id keeps it); (2) the same root path; and (3) Engram's authoritative named_root state reads Bound with the same workspace, generation and named_at. Otherwise it allocates a NEW generation above every earlier one. So a re-name that returns the SAME generation is positive confirmation that the naming is current and bound for this claim. Don't force a clear to get a new number. A NEW number means the old binding had been released, ended or replaced, which is the case that caused the cd57-style evaluation 409s. This refines the "re-name at the carry after a lapse" rule: always re-name, and either outcome is fine. Tonight's same-generation cases: 1a (706 and 733), BarA1 w-c2422 (732), BarA2 w-462 (696), CSharpProof w-cd57 (698).
